title: UfficioFacile
shortDescription: Guides, document checklists and reminders for everyday paperwork in Italy.
fullDescription:
Organize everyday paperwork in Italy with UfficioFacile. Find practical administrative guides, prepare the information you need and keep track of your next steps.

Browse guidance about housing and rent, utilities, municipal services, healthcare administration, work, university, benefits and other everyday procedures. Search by topic and open links to the relevant official sources.

Use your personal workspace to save requests, organize document checklists, record costs and follow deadlines with optional reminders. Public guidance is available without an account. An account is used for personal features and synchronization. Some content and services require Premium or a separate purchase. Availability can vary by service.

Choose English, Italian, French, Spanish, Persian, Arabic, Simplified Chinese or Hebrew.

UfficioFacile is an independent information and organization service. It is not a government app and is not affiliated with the Italian government, INPS, ASL or any public authority. It does not make official decisions on applications. Confirm requirements, forms, fees and deadlines with the responsible office.

Official information sources include INPS (https://www.inps.it/), Agenzia delle Entrate (https://www.agenziaentrate.gov.it/), the Italian Ministry of Health (https://www.salute.gov.it/), and the municipalities linked in the app. Additional source links are available at https://ufficiofacile-info.vercel.app/sources.
